message: The other night, we had a little blackout, and my friend Sarah texted me in a panic. I could practically hear her heart racing through the screen! I reminded her to grab her flashlight and keep her phone charged with a power bank. We ended up having a fun chat by lantern light, sharing stories and laughing about our childhood adventures. It's funny how a little darkness can bring us together. Have you ever had a friend who panics during outages? What do you do to keep things light?
